title: The family
subtitle: mother, uncle, relatives
summary: Name the people in a family - parents, grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins - and talk about your own.

lesson.heading: Family words
lesson.text: The people in your family are your **relatives** or your **relations**. Both words mean the same thing. Here is the Sorokin family, which we use all through this unit.

examples.text: Anne has a big family. She has a lot of **relatives**.
We invited all our **relations** to the wedding.

lesson.heading: The Sorokin family
rows: Amelia / Ivan (married to Anne) / George (married to Meena)
Karen and Jack (Ivan and Anne's) / Ravi and Kavita (George and Meena's)
lesson.note: A '+' means the two people are married.

lesson.heading: Parents and children
lesson.text: A **husband** and **wife** are married to each other. Together they are the **parents** of their children. A girl is a **daughter**, a boy is a **son**. Children of the same parents are **sisters** and **brothers**.

examples.text: Ivan is Anne's **husband** and Karen and Jack's **father**.
Anne is Ivan's **wife** and Karen and Jack's **mother**.
Karen is Anne and Ivan's **daughter**. Jack is their **son**.
Karen is Jack's **sister**. Jack is Karen's **brother**.

lesson.heading: Grandparents and grandchildren
lesson.text: Your father's and mother's parents are your **grandparents**: your **grandfather** and your **grandmother**. You are their **grandson** or **granddaughter**, and all of you together are their **grandchildren**.

examples.text: Henry is Karen and Jack's **grandfather**. Diana is their **grandmother**.
Henry and Diana are Karen and Jack's **grandparents**.
Karen is Henry and Diana's **granddaughter**. Jack is their **grandson**.

lesson.heading: Aunts, uncles, nieces, nephews and cousins
lesson.text: Your parent's brother is your **uncle** and your parent's sister is your **aunt**. You are their **nephew** (a boy) or their **niece** (a girl). Their children are your **cousins** - the word is the same for a boy and a girl.

examples.text: Amelia and Meena are Karen and Jack's **aunts**.
Karen is Amelia, George and Meena's **niece**. Jack is their **nephew**.
Kavita and Ravi are Karen and Jack's **cousins**.

lesson.heading: Talking about your family
lesson.text: These are the questions people ask about your family, and the usual answers. A child with no brothers or sisters is an **only child**.

examples.text: *A:* Have you got any brothers and sisters? *B:* No, I am **an only child**.
*A:* Do you come from a big family? *B:* Yes, I have three brothers and two sisters.

lesson.text: Watch the plural: we say *my wife* and *his wife*, but *our wives* and *their wives* - not ~~our wifes~~.

exercises.prompt: Kavita and Ravi have the same parents. Ravi is Kavita's ___.
exercises.explanation: A boy with the same parents as you is your brother.

exercises.prompt: Anne is married to Ivan, and Ivan is Kavita's uncle. So Anne is Kavita's ___.
exercises.explanation: Your uncle's wife is your aunt.

exercises.prompt: Diana is the mother of Ravi's father. What is she to Ravi?
exercises.explanation: Your parent's mother is your grandmother.

exercises.prompt: Ivan is the father of Karen and Jack, and the uncle of Ravi and Kavita. Match each person to what they are to Ivan.
Karen and Ravi are the children of two brothers. Karen is Ravi's ___.
exercises.hint: (the same word for a boy or a girl)
exercises.explanation: The children of your aunt or uncle are your cousins.

exercises.statement: Meena is married to George, so Meena is George's wife.
exercises.explanation: Correct. A married woman is her husband's wife.

exercises.prompt: Put each family word into the right group.
Sanjay and his wife have one son, Prem. Prem has no brothers or sisters, so he is an ___.
exercises.explanation: A child with no brothers or sisters is an only child.

exercises.prompt: Ask a new friend about their brothers and sisters.
exercises.answer: Have you got any brothers and sisters?

exercises.statement: Ivan and George love their grandparents and visit them with their wifes as often as possible.
exercises.explanation: Ivan and George love their grandparents and visit them with their wives as often as possible. The plural of wife is wives.

exercises.prompt: Alexander and Leila are Henry's parents. Amelia, Ivan and George are Henry's children. What are Amelia, Ivan and George to Alexander and Leila?
exercises.explanation: Your children's children are your grandchildren.

exercises.prompt: Ask someone whether their family is a big one.
exercises.answer: Do you come from a big family?

exercises.prompt: Ivan and George are brothers. Their parents, Henry and Diana, are the ___ of Karen, Jack, Ravi and Kavita.
exercises.explanation: Your parents' parents are your grandparents.
